kicker: WHEN LIFE KNOCKS YOU OFF TRACK
title: Missing once is fine. Never *miss twice.*

label: WHY IT WORKS
head: One miss is a speed bump
sub: Two in a row is where the spiral starts.

head: After a cheat meal
r: Next meal goes back to normal

head: After a skipped workout
l: Skip the rest of the week

label: RULE 2
head: A 40% day still counts
sub: Trained once and hit your protein 4 of 7 days? You stayed in the game.

label: MEASURE IT RIGHT
head: Compare your week to doing nothing
sub: Not to your best week ever.

text: Bounce back faster. Three weeks, then three days, then the *next meal.*

head: Write it on your mirror: *I never miss twice.*
